result.summary:
Wrote both test files verbatim from docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-035.md (apps/bot/src/domain/registrationApproval.db.test.ts, apps/bot/src/handlers/organizerRequests.db.test.ts), with one lint-driven deletion of a dead helper (commandUpdate in organizerRequests.db.test.ts -- defined by the spec's verbatim source but never called by any of the spec's own AC cases; removing unused dead code, not altering any test's logic/assertions). npm run lint -w apps/bot: PASS (clean, zero errors after the dead-code removal). npm run build -w apps/bot: PASS (tsc -p tsconfig.json, clean).

Scratch Postgres (apps/bot's docker-compose, port 55432) was already up; ran `DATABASE_URL=postgres://bot:bot@localhost:55432/bot npx drizzle-kit migrate` from apps/bot to confirm current -- succeeded, no new migrations for REQ-035 as the spec noted.

Full suite (`npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` from repo root) run TWICE: both runs identical -- 'Test Files 2 failed | 37 passed (39)', 'Tests 8 failed | 350 passed (358)'. Zero variance between runs.

Concurrency stability check on apps/bot/src/domain/registrationApproval.db.test.ts, run in isolation THREE additional times: all three identical -- 'Tests 3 failed | 4 passed (7)' each time. The two AC5 'it' cases (20x2 last-seat race; 5x10 fan-in race with dedicated max:30 pool and pool.totalCount>1 evidence) PASSED in every one of 5 total executions (2 full-suite + 3 isolated) -- fully deterministic, zero flakiness observed on the highest-risk case. The three AC10 cases in the same file failed identically in all three isolated runs -- also fully deterministic (not flaky), same root cause every time.

ROOT CAUSE (identical across all 8 failures, in both files): apps/bot/src/domain/registration.ts lines 242-254 (registerForEvent, pre-existing code predating REQ-035, unchanged by this requirement) unconditionally writes an audit_log row for every registration outcome including 'requested' (action: 'registration.request', entityId: the new registration's id). The test spec's countAuditRows() before/after baselines in AC2, AC4, AC6, AC7, AC10 assume zero audit rows exist for a freshly-seeded pending registration, which is false -- every seedPendingRequest() call already produces one audit_log row before any approve/reject call. This is an off-by-one spec defect (TEST-DESIGNER's baseline assumption), not a BACKEND-DEV code defect: the writeAuditLog call is unconditional, intentional, and untouched by REQ-035's actual diff. Per this run's explicit instruction, did NOT silently alter the test files' assertions to force a pass -- stopping and reporting precisely instead, with the exact line numbers, expected-vs-actual values, and recommended fix (adjust every baseline by +1) written into test-reports/report-2026-09-08-WF02-REQ-035.yaml.

All non-audit-count assertions in the 5 affected describe blocks (AC2, AC4, AC6, AC7, AC10) passed correctly: admission-state transitions, qr_token issuance, notification content/counts, authorization refusals, and audit action strings/payloads are all correct per the actual implementation. Only the raw audit-row COUNT assertions are wrong, by exactly the same +1 in every case.

AC1, AC3, AC5, AC8, AC9 fully pass with no issues.

issues.title: REQ-035 test spec: countAuditRows() baselines off by one due to registerForEvent's pre-existing 'registration.request' audit row
issues.description: docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-035.md's AC2/AC4/AC6/AC7/AC10 cases in both new test files assert countAuditRows(registrationId) baselines (before approve/reject: expect 0; after: expect exactly N) without accounting for apps/bot/src/domain/registration.ts:242-254's unconditional writeAuditLog call on every registerForEvent outcome including 'requested'. Every seedPendingRequest() helper call already produces one 'registration.request' audit row before any approve/reject. All 8 affected assertions fail deterministically (confirmed across 5 total suite/file executions, zero flakiness) with actual counts exactly +1 over expected. Recommended fix: TEST-DESIGNER adjusts each baseline by +1 (or the shared seed helpers assert/consume the known pre-existing row so downstream checks read as deltas). Full per-assertion evidence (file, line, expected, actual) is in test-reports/report-2026-09-08-WF02-REQ-035.yaml.
